packages.name: DeepChem
packages.description: Deep learning library for drug discovery, materials science, and quantum chemistry. Provides molecular featurizers, graph neural networks, and pre-trained models for property prediction.
packages.help_text: pip install deepchem. GPU recommended for training. Supports TensorFlow and PyTorch backends.
packages.scientific_context: Molecular property prediction, ADMET, virtual screening, de novo design

packages.name: TorchDrug
packages.description: PyTorch-based library for drug discovery with graph neural networks. Supports molecular generation, property prediction, and protein representation learning.
packages.help_text: pip install torchdrug. Requires PyTorch 1.8+ and torch-scatter for graph operations.
packages.scientific_context: Graph neural networks, molecular generation, retrosynthesis, protein function prediction

packages.name: PyTorch Geometric
packages.description: Geometric deep learning extension library for PyTorch. Foundation for graph neural networks on molecules, proteins, and biological networks.
packages.help_text: Install with: pip install torch-geometric. GPU strongly recommended.
packages.scientific_context: Graph neural networks, molecular representations, protein structure, network analysis

packages.name: MedChem
packages.description: Medicinal chemistry filters and rules for drug-likeness assessment. Implements PAINS, Brenk, NIH, and other structural alert filters.
packages.help_text: pip install medchem. Pure Python with RDKit dependency.
packages.scientific_context: Lead optimization, PAINS filtering, structural alerts, drug-likeness

packages.name: Molfeat
packages.description: Unified molecular featurization library. Provides fingerprints, descriptors, and learned representations from multiple backends.
packages.help_text: pip install molfeat. Supports RDKit, Mordred, and transformer-based featurizers.
packages.scientific_context: Molecular fingerprints, descriptors, QSAR features, ML preprocessing

packages.name: Datamol
packages.description: Lightweight molecular manipulation toolkit built on RDKit. Simplifies common cheminformatics operations.
packages.help_text: pip install datamol. Designed for clean, Pythonic molecular manipulation.
packages.scientific_context: Molecule standardization, SMILES handling, structure preprocessing

packages.name: PyTDC
packages.description: Therapeutics Data Commons - curated ML-ready datasets for drug discovery including ADMET, DTI, and clinical trial outcomes.
packages.help_text: pip install PyTDC. Provides standardized train/valid/test splits.
packages.scientific_context: Benchmark datasets, ADMET prediction, drug-target interaction, model evaluation

packages.name: gget
packages.description: Efficient gene and protein sequence retrieval from Ensembl, UniProt, NCBI, and PDB with a simple Python/CLI interface.
packages.help_text: pip install gget. Simple interface: gget.seq('BRCA1') returns sequences.
packages.scientific_context: Sequence retrieval, gene annotation, protein sequences, genomic coordinates

packages.name: CellxGene Census
packages.description: Access CZI CellxGene Census - largest standardized single-cell RNA-seq data collection with 50M+ cells.
packages.help_text: pip install cellxgene-census. Uses TileDB for efficient slicing of large datasets.
packages.scientific_context: Single-cell atlas, cell type annotation, cross-study analysis, reference mapping

packages.name: COBRApy
packages.description: Constraint-based metabolic modeling in Python. Flux balance analysis, gene knockouts, and metabolic network reconstruction.
packages.help_text: pip install cobra. Supports SBML models from BiGG, KEGG, and custom reconstructions.
packages.scientific_context: Flux balance analysis, metabolic engineering, gene essentiality, pathway analysis

packages.name: Arboreto
packages.description: Gene regulatory network inference using tree-based methods (GRNBoost2, GENIE3). Core of SCENIC pipeline.
packages.help_text: pip install arboreto. Uses Dask for distributed computation on large datasets.
packages.scientific_context: Gene regulatory networks, transcription factors, SCENIC, network inference

packages.name: PyMC
packages.description: Probabilistic programming library for Bayesian statistical modeling and inference using MCMC and variational methods.
packages.help_text: pip install pymc. Version 5+ uses PyTensor backend.
packages.scientific_context: Bayesian inference, uncertainty quantification, hierarchical models, MCMC

packages.name: PyMatGen
packages.description: Python Materials Genomics library for materials analysis, structure manipulation, and interface to Materials Project.
packages.help_text: pip install pymatgen. API key needed for Materials Project queries.
packages.scientific_context: Crystal structures, electronic properties, phase diagrams, materials discovery
